reviews.t: Didn’t know I needed it until I got it
reviews.x: Beautiful product and feels so good gliding over my face after I apply my serum. Put it in fridge as suggested during hot weather and it’s so soothing. Company sent me a separate how to Email which was very helpful.

reviews.t: Amazing, feels so good and makes a difference
reviews.x: I am so in love with my rose quartz roller that I've been telling everyone I know about it. I use it every day and look forward to it... I'm guilty of using it two or three times in a day. It just feels so good! People told me about the health benefits, but never how good it actually feels. It's like a massage for your face. It's also helped a bit with my jaw tension. I noticed a healthy glow just a week or two after using the product daily. I'd recommend this product to anyone!

reviews.t: Roller doesn't spin all the way around, no directions.
reviews.x: No directions or "quick start" to get you started with Gua Sha, so expect to google/buy a separate book. The quality of the Rose Quartz is nice and has good color, but the construction of the eye roller is a bit janky. The smaller roller on mine doesn't spin fully around, it gets caught and you have to switch directions, so it's annoying to use.  Seems like they don't have good QC for the product checking each roller after manufacture.

There has been a lot of hype around facial rollers, and from my experience I would definitely recommend getting one.  I have been using my roller for about two months.  It has helped reduce puffiness, and relieve a lot of tension in my face and neck.  I dropped my roller and it broke in half, but it is still usable- no other issues besides that.  It is good quality for the price.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the roller beautiful, well-packaged, and of good quality, often exceeding their expectations.
Several reviewers report the roller helps with sinus pressure, allergies, and facial puffiness, especially when kept in the fridge for cooling.
A few reviewers report durability problems, with the roller breaking or coming apart shortly after arrival.
Some reviewers praise responsive customer service that replaced a defective unit.
A couple of reviewers complain of poor quality, including residue on the roller and doubts about review authenticity.
